name: qjs_framework_vtable

ownership.argument: Framework RAM dispatcher table (two Itanium prefix words then the primary slots). Slot 8 is the Application factory. The module copies the table and replaces only that slot through the Supervisor pointer hook.

provenance.source: Exact xiaomi-band-11-4.100.139 image/IDB, compared with xiaomi-band-11-4.100.155: the whole 15-word table at 0x2ca8066c equals the .155 table at 0x2ca8065c with every entry shifted by the same +0x10, and two matched functions reference it from the same instruction position.

notes: Address catalogue only; the table layout is proven equal to the .155 audit.
